articles.headline: Sensex, Nifty open flat
articles.blurb: The BSE Sensex opened flat at 84,321.54 and the Nifty at 25,809.40 in early trade on Friday amid mixed global cues.

articles.headline: Firms’ FY26 revenue growth likely to be 6.5%-7.5%, says CRISIL
articles.blurb: CRISIL said Indian firms’ revenue growth is likely to stay in the 6.5%–7.5% band in FY26, with services and domestic consumption supporting earnings while export-linked sectors face headwinds.

articles.headline: RBI fines Karur Vysya Bank ₹66 lakh
articles.blurb: The Reserve Bank of India fined Karur Vysya Bank ₹66 lakh for deficiencies in regulatory compliance, the bank disclosed in an exchange filing.

articles.headline: MEA official to head global affairs at Flipkart
articles.blurb: Flipkart appointed Ministry of External Affairs official Pragya Sharma to lead global affairs as the e-commerce firm expands cross-border operations.

articles.headline: Cautious sentiment in equity market to continue for 4-6 quarters, says Marcellus
articles.blurb: Marcellus Investment Managers said cautious equity sentiment could persist for four to six quarters, citing valuations and earnings visibility.

articles.headline: Govt. committed to fiscal consolidation, says Finance Ministry
articles.blurb: The Finance Ministry reiterated commitment to fiscal consolidation and stated that the Centre would stay on the glide path for the deficit despite spending pressures.

articles.headline: RBI has no plan for dedicated gold regulator, says Das
articles.blurb: RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das said the central bank has no proposal to create a separate gold regulator and that existing frameworks would continue to govern the market.

articles.headline: RBI to hold rates for longer, say HSBC and StanC
articles.blurb: HSBC and Standard Chartered economists said they expect the RBI to keep policy rates unchanged for longer as inflation stays within tolerance bands.

articles.headline: RBI to conduct OMO sale of ₹25,000 cr. G-Secs on Oct. 23
articles.blurb: The RBI said it will conduct an open-market sale of ₹25,000 crore of government securities on October 23 to manage liquidity.

articles.headline: Bank unions seek pay revision talks with IBA
articles.blurb: United Forum of Bank Unions sought early wage-revision talks with the Indian Banks’ Association, citing pending settlements for public-sector bank staff.

articles.headline: GIC, other insurers join $250 mn. round in Meesho
articles.blurb: General Insurance Corporation of India and other insurers joined a $250 million funding round in Meesho as the quick-commerce and marketplace firm raised fresh capital.

articles.headline: India, U.S. agree to cut tariff on Indian goods to 18% for 90 days
articles.blurb: India and the United States agreed to cut tariffs on Indian goods to 18% for 90 days as part of a trade truce, with officials saying the deal covers several tariff lines while broader negotiations continue.

articles.headline: Govt. forms panel under Krishna to speed up mining reform
articles.blurb: The Union government set up a panel under former Supreme Court judge Justice B.N. Srikrishna to recommend steps to speed up mining-sector reforms and clearance processes.

articles.headline: Army Chief warns Pakistan against using terror infrastructure
articles.blurb: Army Chief General Upendra Dwivedi warned Pakistan against using terror infrastructure against India, saying the Army would respond firmly to cross-border threats.

articles.headline: U.S. envoy to visit Kolkata on Oct. 21
articles.blurb: The U.S. envoy is scheduled to visit Kolkata on October 21 for diplomatic engagements, the Ministry of External Affairs said.

articles.headline: Modi, Murmu at Ganga aarti in Patna
articles.blurb: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Droupadi Murmu attended a Ganga aarti in Patna during Bihar visit events on Thursday evening.

articles.headline: Rahul to visit families of SIR protest detentions on Oct. 18
articles.blurb: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi will visit families of people detained during special intensive revision protests on October 18, the party announced.

articles.headline: Protests continue in Maharashtra
articles.blurb: Demonstrations over electoral roll revision continued in Maharashtra on Thursday with opposition parties demanding transparency from the Election Commission.

articles.headline: Over 3,000 more held in Bengal, says CM
articles.blurb: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee said police detained more than 3,000 additional protesters during continuing SIR-related demonstrations in the State.

articles.headline: 20 students get stuck in flooded lift in Chandigarh
articles.blurb: Twenty students were rescued after a lift they were in flooded during heavy rain at a coaching centre in Chandigarh; none were seriously injured.

articles.headline: Belagavi district panchayat meeting focuses on water, roads
articles.blurb: The Belagavi zilla panchayat meeting prioritised drinking-water schemes and road works, with members noting about ₹50 crore in central funds for rural infrastructure.

articles.headline: D.C. asks officials to check if schools are not forcing students to attend on Dasara holiday
articles.blurb: Dakshina Kannada Deputy Commissioner directed officials to ensure schools do not compel students to attend classes on the Dasara holiday.

articles.headline: BJP MLC Hartal Haladi visits Karwar SIR camp
articles.blurb: BJP MLC Hartal Haladi visited a special intensive revision camp in Karwar and reviewed verification of electoral rolls with local officials.

articles.headline: Congress worker dies at Belagavi protest clash
articles.blurb: A Congress worker died after a clash during a protest in Belagavi; police said they are investigating the circumstances and identifying those involved.

articles.headline: Prohibitory orders in Udupi for Deepavali fireworks
articles.blurb: Udupi district authorities issued prohibitory orders restricting fireworks in designated areas ahead of Deepavali celebrations.

articles.headline: Momentum gathers for annual Mangaluru Dasara
articles.blurb: Organisers said preparations for Mangaluru Dasara are in full swing with cultural programmes and processions scheduled across the city.

articles.headline: JCI Lions Dasara at Milagres: Vishalakshi Tantri crowned
articles.blurb: JCI Lions Mangalore crowned Vishalakshi Tantri at the Milagres Church Dasara celebrations after a cultural pageant in the city.

articles.headline: SRI Lankadeepa ship brings vehicles to Old Port
articles.blurb: The Sri Lankadeepa vessel berthed at Mangaluru Old Port with imported vehicles as port officials cleared cargo for inland movement.

articles.headline: Congress plans protest outside Raj Bhavan
articles.blurb: Karnataka Congress leaders planned a demonstration outside Raj Bhavan in Bengaluru over Governor-State relations and pending bills.

articles.headline: Dharam Singh writes to Governor over pending bills
articles.blurb: Senior Congress leader Dharam Singh wrote to the Karnataka Governor urging assent to bills passed by the State legislature that remain pending.

articles.headline: Tipu Jayanti event deferred
articles.blurb: The Siddaramaiah government deferred the Tipu Jayanti commemoration event amid political objections from the opposition.

articles.headline: Rowdy elements will not be spared, says Chamarajanagar SP
articles.blurb: Chamarajanagar Superintendent of Police warned that rowdy elements would not be spared after a series of law-and-order incidents in the district.

articles.headline: Nadda meets doctors after Dharma Sansad threats
articles.blurb: BJP president J.P. Nadda met doctors’ representatives after threats linked to a Dharma Sansad, assuring protection for medical professionals and hospitals.

articles.headline: AAP accuses BJP of ‘fake polio drive’ in Delhi
articles.blurb: AAP accused the BJP of running a fake polio vaccination drive in Delhi; the BJP rejected the charge and said the immunisation programme follows Union Health Ministry protocols.

articles.headline: EC defends second SIR phase; 2.21 crore objections filed
articles.blurb: The Election Commission said more than 2.21 crore objections were filed in the second phase of special intensive revision and defended the process as transparent.

articles.headline: Congress asks EC to come clean on SIR
articles.blurb: Congress demanded the Election Commission explain SIR data discrepancies after the Central Information Commission issued a show-cause notice to the poll body.

articles.headline: U.P. SIR phase from Nov. 10 in 30 districts
articles.blurb: Uttar Pradesh will begin the next SIR phase from November 10 across 30 districts, State election officials announced.

articles.headline: Punjab CM to meet Khattar on Nov. 4 over Punjab SIR
articles.blurb: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann will meet Haryana counterpart Manohar Lal Khattar on November 4 to discuss Punjab’s special intensive revision schedule.

articles.headline: CBI probe into Kalkaji temple land scam
articles.blurb: The CBI registered a case into alleged irregularities in Kalkaji temple land deals in Delhi following a court directive.

articles.headline: SC allows Delhi firecrackers only in 2-hour Deepavali window
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court permitted green firecrackers in Delhi only during a two-hour window on Deepavali night, reiterating curbs on pollution.

articles.headline: SC asks BCCI to act after Pakistan’s 10-wicket win
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court asked the BCCI to respond after Pakistan’s 10-wicket win in a bilateral context raised governance questions in a pending plea.

articles.headline: Supreme Court rejects Nithyananda order plea
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court rejected a plea related to an order concerning self-styled godman Nithyananda, upholding the lower court’s decision.

articles.headline: Israel kills Hamas deputy Rawhi Mushtaha
articles.blurb: Israel said it killed Hamas deputy leader Rawhi Mushtaha in Gaza as fighting continued; Hamas confirmed a senior commander died in the strike.

articles.headline: Russia launches massive attack on Kyiv
articles.blurb: Russia launched a large missile and drone attack on Kyiv, injuring civilians and damaging infrastructure, Ukrainian officials said.

articles.headline: 5.7 quake near Haiti
articles.blurb: A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck near Haiti; authorities reported minor damage and no immediate tsunami warning.

articles.headline: Trump calls off trade talks with Canada
articles.blurb: U.S. President Donald Trump said he called off trade talks with Canada over tariff disputes on dairy and lumber imports.

articles.headline: Pope warns against greed
articles.blurb: Pope Leo XIV warned against greed and inequality in a homily, urging leaders to protect the poor amid global economic strains.

articles.headline: Hamas says it is open to talks
articles.blurb: Hamas said it remains open to ceasefire talks while demanding an end to the Gaza blockade, mediators in Cairo reported.

articles.headline: ACB officers raid Town Municipal Council, arrest three
articles.blurb: Anti-Corruption Bureau officers raided a town municipal council office in Dakshina Kannada and arrested three officials in a bribery case.

articles.headline: NPF leader killed in accident
articles.blurb: A Nagarika Hitarakshana Samiti leader died in a road accident in the district; police said the car collided with a divider on the highway.

articles.headline: Police warn against reckless driving during Deepavali
articles.blurb: Mangaluru City Police warned motorists against reckless and drunk driving during Deepavali, announcing checkpoints and fines.

articles.headline: Mangaluru airport to resume international operations on Oct. 19
articles.blurb: Mangaluru International Airport will resume international flights from October 19 after terminal upgrade work, officials said.

articles.headline: Mangalore University V.C. selected for National Education Policy awards
articles.blurb: Mangalore University Vice Chancellor P. Subrahmanya Yadapadithaya was selected for National Education Policy implementation awards at the institutional level.

articles.headline: BJP to celebrate Deepavali with ration card holders
articles.blurb: Dakshina Kannada BJP said it will distribute sweets to ration-card holders across the district during Deepavali visits by office-bearers.

articles.headline: District in-charge Minister to open Dasara in Subrahmanya
articles.blurb: District in-charge Minister U.T. Khader will inaugurate Dasara festivities at Subrahmanya temple in Dakshina Kannada.

articles.headline: Mangaluru police bust ganja racket
articles.blurb: City police arrested two persons and seized ganja in a raid on a racket operating near Mangaluru, an official release said.

articles.headline: Mangaluru police hold flag march
articles.blurb: Mangaluru City Police conducted a flag march in sensitive areas ahead of Deepavali to deter rowdy activity.

articles.headline: Mangaluru police arrest chain snatchers
articles.blurb: Police arrested two chain snatchers and recovered gold ornaments stolen in separate incidents in the city.

articles.headline: Govt. all set to start work on airport international terminal, says Mangaluru MP
articles.blurb: Mangaluru MP B. Yogeshwar said work on the international terminal at Mangaluru airport will begin soon with central and State clearances in place.

articles.headline: No shortage of police to fight terror in Mangaluru, says City Police Commissioner
articles.blurb: City Police Commissioner Anupam Agarwal said Mangaluru has adequate police strength and intelligence cover to counter terror threats.

articles.headline: Cong. plans to pick 30 candidates for 2027 civic polls
articles.blurb: Mangaluru City Congress said it will finalise about 30 candidates for the 2027 municipal corporation elections after ward-level surveys.

articles.headline: BJP district president Kateel on Deepavali ration outreach
articles.blurb: Dakshina Kannada BJP president Nalin Kumar Kateel said party workers will visit ration-card families during Deepavali with sweets and listen to grievances.

articles.headline: Anti-romeo, anti-drug and ganja drives ahead of Deepavali season
articles.blurb: Mangaluru police launched anti-romeo, anti-drug and anti-ganja drives in malls, beaches and student hubs before Deepavali.

articles.headline: Anti-dowry rally from Swaraj Maidan to Kadri
articles.blurb: The police department and NGOs organised an anti-dowry rally from Swaraj Maidan to Kadri, urging families to reject dowry demands.

articles.headline: Traffic police fine 3,760 for helmet violations in first six hours
articles.blurb: Mangaluru traffic police fined 3,760 two-wheeler riders for helmet violations in the first six hours of a special drive on Friday.

articles.headline: MCC conducts 48th ward panel meeting
articles.blurb: Mangaluru City Corporation held the 48th ward committee meeting to review sanitation, streetlights and pending civic works.

articles.headline: SC questions States on SIR data mismatch
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court asked several States to explain mismatches between special intensive revision data and census figures, giving short deadlines for affidavits.

articles.headline: SC sets up panel on stray dog menace
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court constituted a panel to recommend measures to control stray dog attacks while balancing animal welfare laws.

articles.headline: India raises concerns over U.S. military action, says Jaishankar
articles.blurb: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar said India raised concerns with the U.S. over military actions affecting regional stability during bilateral talks.

articles.headline: 2+2 dialogue next week, says U.S. envoy Blome
articles.blurb: U.S. envoy Eric Garcetti’s deputy said the India-U.S. 2+2 dialogue is scheduled next week with defence and foreign ministers meeting in Delhi.

articles.headline: CJI: Caste discrimination can be ended
articles.blurb: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said caste discrimination can be ended through education and strict enforcement of constitutional equality.

articles.headline: BJP in a state of deep worry, says Ajit
articles.blurb: NCP leader Ajit Pawar said the BJP is in deep worry ahead of local polls and accused the ruling alliance of avoiding accountability on SIR.

articles.headline: Naveen files nomination for LS seat
articles.blurb: Former Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik filed nomination papers for the upcoming Lok Sabha by-election in Kendrapara.

articles.headline: 20% reservation for women in T.N. jobs
articles.blurb: Tamil Nadu announced 20% horizontal reservation for women in direct recruitment to government posts, citing gender parity goals.

articles.headline: Naxalite hideout busted in Chhattisgarh
articles.blurb: Security forces busted a Naxalite hideout in Chhattisgarh’s Bastar region, seizing explosives and literature, police said.

articles.headline: Manipur govt. cancels agreement over Kuki burial site
articles.blurb: The Manipur government cancelled an agreement with Kuki groups on a burial site after protests from other communities in the valley.

articles.headline: Kerala MLA suspended for assault on fellow legislator
articles.blurb: The Kerala Assembly suspended an MLA for assaulting a fellow legislator inside the House; the Speaker referred the matter to a privileges panel.

articles.headline: Four arrested in Rajasthan in NCR ‘digital arrest’ case
articles.blurb: Rajasthan Police arrested four persons for allegedly defrauding a retired official through a ‘digital arrest’ phone scam in the NCR region.

articles.headline: NEET row: CBI charges 27 in Bihar paper leak
articles.blurb: The CBI filed charges against 27 people in the Bihar NEET-UG paper leak case, naming coaching centres and officials accused of distributing questions.

articles.headline: SC directs IIT-Delhi committee on NEET evaluation
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court asked an IIT-Delhi committee to examine NEET answer-key grievances and submit a report within a fixed timeline.

articles.headline: NEET row: Bihar STF probe continues
articles.blurb: Bihar’s Special Task Force said its parallel NEET leak probe continues after seizures of devices and question papers from multiple districts.

articles.headline: Education Ministry on board exam reforms
articles.blurb: The Education Ministry briefed stakeholders on proposed board exam reforms, emphasising competency-based questions from the next academic cycle.

articles.headline: Modi to hold 16th BRICS Summit in Kazan
articles.blurb: Prime Minister Narendra Modi travels to Kazan for the 16th BRICS Summit, where leaders will discuss payment systems and Global South cooperation.

articles.headline: Maldives President Muizzu meets Modi
articles.blurb: Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu met Prime Minister Modi on the BRICS sidelines to discuss maritime security and development aid.

articles.headline: Pakistan PM at SCO meeting
articles.blurb: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif attended the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation meeting, calling for regional connectivity projects.

articles.headline: Jaishankar on BRICS expansion
articles.blurb: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar said BRICS expansion should reflect balanced representation without turning the bloc into an anti-West platform.

articles.headline: RCB fans celebrate at Chinnaswamy after IPL title
articles.blurb: Royal Challengers Bengaluru fans filled Chinnaswamy Stadium for a victory parade after the franchise won its first IPL title.

articles.headline: Delhi Capitals women reach WPL final
articles.blurb: Delhi Capitals defeated Mumbai Indians to reach the Women’s Premier League final, led by a half-century from their captain.

articles.headline: Kohli hints at retirement timeline after century
articles.blurb: Virat Kohli said he will decide on retirement after the Australia tour, hours after scoring a century in a limited-overs fixture.

articles.headline: Prannoy advances at Denmark Open
articles.blurb: Indian shuttler Prannoy HS reached the Denmark Open quarter-finals with a straight-games win over a higher-ranked opponent.

articles.headline: Sunrisers Hyderabad retain Marco Jansen
articles.blurb: Sunrisers Hyderabad retained South African all-rounder Marco Jansen ahead of the IPL mega auction using a right-to-match card.

articles.headline: Mangaluru’s love for fish, neer dosa and chicken ghee roast
articles.blurb: Metro Plus profiles Mangaluru’s coastal cuisine—fish curry, neer dosa and chicken ghee roast—and lists popular eateries locals frequent during Dasara season.

articles.headline: Recipe: Mangalorean chicken ghee roast
articles.blurb: The Metro Plus recipe column gives step-by-step instructions for Mangalorean chicken ghee roast with Byadgi chilli and ghee tempering.

articles.headline: Maximum temperature levels recorded in the national capital
articles.blurb: Delhi recorded a maximum of 32°C on Thursday, 2.2 notches below normal, and a minimum of 24.4°C, 1.4 notches above normal, IMD data show.

articles.headline: Number of migrants dead in Djibouti boat accident
articles.blurb: At least 109 migrants died and 116 remain missing after a boat capsized off Djibouti; about 80 survivors were rescued, a UN agency said.

articles.headline: Number of people who died in U.S. Cyclone Isaias
articles.blurb: Hurricane Isaias was linked to at least four deaths in the U.S. and left nearly 700,000 customers without power, AFP reported.

articles.headline: Why UAPA demands urgent reform (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Gautam Bhatia argues vague UAPA membership clauses and strict bail rules have jailed activists and scholars for years without trial, citing G.N. Saibaba’s decade in prison and Bhima Koregaon cases.

articles.headline: Global warming is turning sex reversal in frogs into extinction risk
articles.blurb: Hungarian research in Science Advances shows heatwaves can turn genetic female agile frogs into functional males, skewing sex ratios toward extinction risk.

articles.headline: Jonathan, world’s oldest known land animal
articles.blurb: Scientists study 184-year-old Aldabra giant tortoise Jonathan on St. Helena to understand extreme longevity mechanisms.

articles.headline: Type I and type II errors
articles.blurb: Vasudevan Mukunth explains false positives and false negatives in statistics, using electoral roll clean-up as an example of trade-offs.

articles.headline: Sridhar U. Achar
articles.blurb: Death notice for Sridhar U. Achar, 72, of Udupi, former bank officer, who died on October 15; cremation at Brahmavar with family requesting privacy.

articles.headline: How to prevent cervical cancer
articles.blurb: Dr. Devika Das of KMC Manipal tells The Hindu HPV vaccination before age 14, regular screening and smoking cessation are key to preventing cervical cancer.

articles.headline: Health roundup: dengue cases in Dakshina Kannada
articles.blurb: District health officials reported a slight rise in dengue cases in Dakshina Kannada and urged residents to remove stagnant water ahead of post-monsoon rains.

articles.headline: Why is Norway considering a temporary smart glasses ban?
articles.blurb: Haider Ali Khan reports Norway may temporarily restrict smart glasses in schools, playgrounds and healthcare settings over covert recording and facial recognition concerns.
